title: Energy cost support for snowmaking
text: Operators may apply for energy efficiency funding when replacing snowmaking equipment with lower consumption systems. Applications need a documented energy audit.

title: Shared data agreement
text: Cooperating operators must anonymize incident and closure data before sharing. Data may be used for risk analysis and adaptation planning only.

title: Summer use of ski lifts
text: Operating a chairlift in summer for hikers or bikers requires a separate safety inspection and an updated operating permit.

title: Avalanche closure duty
text: Operators must close affected lifts and slopes when avalanche warning level four or higher is issued and must report the closure to the local authority.

title: Cross-border cooperation funding
text: Joint projects between operators from at least two Alpine countries can apply for cooperation funding covering adaptation and diversification measures.
